app.title: Nospeaker ─ Make your MacBook's trackpad talk using its haptic motor
app.description: A command‑line utility that outputs haptic feedback through the MacBook trackpad to provide audible or tactile notifications.

Run `nospeaker test` to trigger a short vibration and verify haptic output
Measure latency from command execution to vibration onset
